requirements.quote: Every queued submission is bound to its launch and confirmed conversation at acceptance. Ordinary submissions run FIFO after the current turn and outstanding decisions finish; a queued submission never migrates to a new conversation. Terminal control commands and interruption take priority over waiting ordinary submissions, while retaining observable input order.

While one ACP turn runs, mix human and automated follow-ups. One observable order and FIFO execution after the turn and outstanding decisions finish is shown in the transcript/protocol trace. Ordinary follow-up never cancels an active turn, and every queued submission is bound to launch and confirmed conversation at acceptance.

decision: All five ordinary prompts must execute. The third prompt HOLD keeps the turn active while terminal and installed Bun follow-ups are accepted. Replacing the MCP inspection caller changes no conversation. No interrupt, control, rotation, refusal, or decision blocks precedes release/completion. Pause occurs only after all five completions and correlation. Removing the fifth prompt would violate SR-3.2/AC2.
cause: On jq-1.6, the exact NUL/raw split produces five real elements without a trailing empty element; [:-1] removes the final real prompt. This is an expected-array construction defect.
fix: jq -cn --args '$ARGS.positional' "${texts[@]}" directly preserves all five arguments
preserved: all five submitted texts and admission/completion waits
exact wire order/text/session and raw frames
single starts/outcomes with correlated request/session IDs
